value.rationale: The result quantitatively controls all fibers of the natural divisor-sum ratio, including the equality set in Trudgian’s explicit open infinitude question. The sparsity gain exceeds every fixed power of log X, rather than merely showing zero density. The sharp-looking 1/sqrt2 exponent arises from balancing two intrinsic sources, smooth numbers and repeated large-prime factors, not from an arbitrary finite cutoff. It does not purport to solve infinitude.
